title: What may run at this IRQL?
description:
Check a sequence of calls against the IRQL rules.

```
PASSIVE: ExAllocatePool2(PagedPool) ok
acquire spin lock -> DISPATCH
DISPATCH: ExAllocatePool2(PagedPool) VIOLATION (paged memory at DISPATCH_LEVEL)
DISPATCH: KeSetEvent ok
DISPATCH: KeWaitForSingleObject with a timeout VIOLATION
release spin lock -> PASSIVE
```
hints: Keep a stack of IRQLs so nested acquires and releases restore the right level (lesson 3.02).
Paged memory may be on disk, and the page fault handler cannot run at DISPATCH_LEVEL: that is the reason behind the rule.
requirements: A table of calls with the highest IRQL each may run at.
Spin lock acquire raises to DISPATCH and release lowers it back.
Report each violation with the reason.
stretch: Check the "Pageable code" rule too: functions in a `PAGE` section must not run at DISPATCH.
